content: Yosep ivotia vibiiŋ ru pughudi
Sawa pida inim ila, ghoro uraata ru to kinik to Isip tigham sosor pani. Uraata ru tonowen, eez iŋgin ya vaen to kinik, ve ite iŋgin uraat to moziiŋ mberet.

Yesuru tigham kinik ate yabyab kat. Tovenen ye ighur di tilooŋ tila ruum to yabyabuuŋ lolo. Ruum tonowen, yes ndaaba to tiŋgin ruum to kinik ne, daba todi mata pani. Ve Yosep ineep ila ruum tonowen lolo paam.
Tovenen daba tonowen ighur Yosep pa iŋgin ndiran ru tonenen.
Uraata ru tonenen tinepneep le mboŋ eez, yesuru tivib. Eemoghon vibiiŋ to yesuru, raratedi maau. Pughudi ite ite.
Mboŋmaagh, Yosep ila iŋgig di. Ye ighita naghodi, ve ighilaal ighaze yesuru ledi pataŋani.
Tovenen ighason di ighaze: “You naghita gham naghomim poia maau. Vena, lemim pataŋani eta?”

Yesuru tipamuul aliŋa tighaze: “Mboŋ, yeru nivib. Eemoghon tamtoghon eta ineep sualen pa ivotia vibiiŋ tiei pughudi ne maau.” Yosep isaav padi ighaze: “Saveeŋ tiam, nene onoon. Maaron moghon to irau ivotia vibiiŋ pughu. Poia. Apaesia vibiiŋ tiam payou ve nalooŋ di.”
Tovenen uraata to iŋgin ya vaen to kinik, isavia vibiiŋ toni pa Yosep ighaze: “Vibiiŋ tiou tovene: You naghita ai vaen eez iyoon ila naghog.
Ai tonowen mata supu iza le ighur boga tol. Ghoro rikia moghon irug, ve anoŋa ivot, ve ibulbuul.
Ghoro nagham pida, ve napiis suru izila rubruub to kinik, ve naghami nala, ve nazuzuuna ila to kinik.”
Yosep ilooŋ vibiiŋ toni, ve isaav pani ighaze: “Vibiiŋ tiom, pughu tovene: Ai vaen to ighur boga tol, nene iza to mboŋ tol.
Mboŋ tol inim ila, ghoro tinim iza. Pasa, kinik pale lolo poia payom, ve igham ghom umuul ula pa uraat tiom. Tovenen yom pale uŋgin ya vaen, ve ugham pani ve ighun inimale muuŋ ughamghami.
Ve ulooŋ. Sawa to nepooŋ tiom poia muul, matam iŋgal ghou, ve usavia pataŋani tiou tonene pa kinik. Leso uul ghou, ve anag napul ruum to yabyabuuŋ tonene, ve navot paam.

Pasa, taug lolog ve nanim ndug tonene maau. You naneep izi taan to yes Hibrua, ve tikis ghou ve tigholia ghou nala to tamtoghon pida. Tauto nanim sualen. Ve nagham sosor eta izi sualen paam maau. Tighur ghou nalooŋ nanim ruum to yabyabuuŋ tonene sorok.”

Uraata to iŋgin uraat to moziiŋ mberet, ilooŋ Yosep ivotia ita ite vibiiŋ toni pughu le poia, tovenen ana isavia vibiiŋ toni pa Yosep ighaze: “You paam naghita vibiiŋ eez. Vibiiŋ tiou, tovene: Anunug nalup nakaral tol ve naŋgud di. Nakaral tol tonowen, tivon pa mberet.
Nakaral to ineep iza sala, mberet naol naol to kinik tineep ila lolo. Eemoghon man tiroov tinim, ve tighanghan mberet tonowen le isob.”
Yosep ilooŋ vibiiŋ toni, ve isaav pani ighaze: “Ai, vibiiŋ tiom tonene, pughu tovene. Nakaral tol, nene iza to mboŋ tol.
Mboŋ tol inim ila, ghoro kinik imbut motin luam, ve tisaron patum izala imonau ila ai. Ghoro man tiroov tilat, ve tighan mindam.”

Saveeŋ to Yosep tonene, anoŋa ivot. Mboŋ tol inim ila, ghoro tiza pa sawa to kinik tina ipoopa. Tovenen kinik igham ghanghaniiŋ tiina, ve ipoi uraata toni tisob tinim tilup di ve tighanghan. Ghoro imbaaŋ ila pa uraata to iŋgin ya vaen toni, toman ita ite to iŋgin uraat to moziiŋ mberet, ighaze yesuru tinim paam. Tinim peria, ghoro kinik ipayoon di ila ival tiina matadi,
ve ighur ŋgeu to iŋgin ya vaen, imuul ila pa uraat toni. Tovenen ye ighur rubruub ila kinik nima inimale muuŋ ighamghami.
Eemoghon ita ite to iŋgin uraat to moziiŋ mberet, tirabi imaat ve tisaron paatu izala imonau ila ai. Tovenen mbeb to ivot ne, deŋia itaghon Yosep saveeŋ toni.
Eemoghon ŋgeu to iŋgin ya vaen to kinik, mata iŋgal Yosep maau. Lolo imaagh pani kat.
